# Tampa Auto Rescue

> Tampa Auto Rescue is a 24-hour roadside assistance and towing company serving Tampa, Florida and surrounding areas. We provide emergency towing, jump starts, tire changes, fuel delivery, lockout service, and winch-out vehicle recovery, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Call (813) 555-0199 for immediate help.

## Contact

- Phone: (813) 555-0199 (24/7 dispatch)
- Email: dispatch@tampaautorescue.com
- Service area: Tampa, Brandon, Ybor City, Riverview, Clearwater, St. Petersburg, and nearby Tampa Bay communities
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays

## Services

- [Emergency Towing](https://tampaautorescue.com/towing): 24/7 flatbed towing, accident towing, and long-distance towing across Tampa Bay.
- [Roadside Assistance](https://tampaautorescue.com/roadside-assistance): Jump starts, flat tire changes, fuel delivery, and car lockout service — typically on scene in 30 minutes or less.
- [Vehicle Recovery](https://tampaautorescue.com/recovery): Winch-out and recovery for vehicles stuck in sand, mud, ditches, or off-road situations.
- [Services Overview](https://tampaautorescue.com/services): Full list of roadside services with details.
- [Fleet Partnerships](https://tampaautorescue.com/fleet): Fleet roadside assistance contracts for businesses with multiple vehicles in the Tampa area.

## Common Questions

- How fast can Tampa Auto Rescue arrive? Most calls in the Tampa metro area are answered within 30 minutes.
- Do you operate at night and on holidays? Yes — 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
- Do you tow to any repair shop? Yes, we tow to the shop or location of your choice.
- What areas do you cover? Tampa, Brandon, Ybor City, Riverview, Clearwater, St. Petersburg, and surrounding Tampa Bay areas.
